title: Problems Start with the Rejection of Divine Servanthood
body:
… We are just reaching, from the last three holy months, shahr al-Ramadan. Rajab is for Allah Almighty,
Sha`ban is for the Seal of Prophets (s), and Ramadan is for Ummati Muhammad (s)!
That is our glorifying for our Lord, our Creator, Allah (swt). (...)
O People! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. The
Lord of Heavens, the Creator of all Creation on Earth and in Heavens, everywhere, from the Eternal, the First
and the Last, also. Eternal! No one knows what Eternity is. Allah (swt ), our Lord, He is … frozen … Madad,
yaa RijaalAllah! Madad yaa Sayyidina, yaa Shakhoona! Madad al-Haqq!
We are asking for heavenly support to prepare our own beings. As you can’t bring any description for our
beings, how then are we going to ask about our Lord’s existence? We are only knowing He is Lord of all
Creation, from pre-Eternal up to Eternity. Our understanding of the Lord of Heavens is nothing, but we are
trying to know what He created on Earth and in the Heavens. How are you asking about Him? But so many
shaytanic agents are working to make our beliefs on the wrong way. You are bringing such a foolish question
about the Lord of Heavens, but it is forbidden. First you must look after your own being on this planet. Do
you understand anything about this universe? No, you can’t know; you know nothing. So how are you trying

to jump from this to know the Creator? He is Creator and we are His creatures.
You may make a robot that looks like a man, but you can’t ask that robot to say, “Who made me?” A robot
can’t ask that. If a robot never understands who is its maker, how are you going to ask about your Creator?
Keep adab! But now people are on the wrong way, so proud, asking to run away from servanthood because
they never like to be servants. Shaytan is blowing through them and through every creature, particularly
Mankind, saying, "You must know everything and you are the only one who can be the owner, maker, or
creator of everything."
Shaytan is making people reject servanthood. All troubles are coming from that point, because people are
running away from servanthood. Why are they running away? Because they are saying, "We are special
people on this planet,” and they are not understanding servanthood. I am asking, “If you are so proud that
you are not accepting to be for The One Who brought you to life, I ask, who is steering this planet?” Is anyone
saying who is the driver for this planet? “We are looking, but can’t find any instrument that drives it.” No, you
can’t say, “This car is running and going in a direction by itself,” or people will say, “Take this person to a
mental hospital.”
I am asking `ulama who have so many titles, do you know that nothing can run by itself? Is this dunya
running without a driver? Do you think this? You must be majnoon, crazy. Daily we see the sun rise from the
east. Who is driving it to the west, raising it up and then setting it down? How can you say the sun rises and
sets by itself? If you say this, there must be something wrong with you.
This is such a fine point, that while we are sleeping our sun disappears through a black horizon and after
awhile we see it rise in the opposite direction. Who is making that sun move in the day time and disappear at
night time? People are drunk, particularly learned people; they only know how to deny that beyond the
material aspects there is an unexpected power that makes everything move, particularly our sun. It moves in
the early morning and then after Maghrib it sets down.
I am asking those people who are denying foolishly, and who cause others to deny, that beyond the material
being there is something of Unseen Dominions. In those dominions there is another Creation and its power is
making the sun move and making our world turn on its axis. Yaa Hu! How are they claiming that by itself our
world is moving and knowing its way? Yaa Hu! You may answer that it does so in the way that a blind person

finds his way from the mosque to his home. However, at least he is keeping a stick in his hand and with that
stick he finds his way. Is our sun carrying a stick?
Those materialistic people are no-mind unbelievers whose levels are under that of animals; they say the sun
rises and sets by itself. I hope someone is coming when the Last Day approaches to look after such people and
puts reins on them to lead them to a place and to keep them there. Those are shaytanic tricks to make people
caught in shaytanic traps. That is the main point: now people are never thinking about reality, they are like
animals whose owners lead them with reins. Now the whole world is on the reins of Shaytan, and whatever
Shaytan says they agree, but whatever prophets say they reject. Allah Almighty is going to punish them and
that punishment will begin before the Day of Resurrection. It may be the Lord of Heavens will change those
people to have the face of a donkey and a tail like a fox, so that those who deny everything will be punished.
Don’t be astonished if some people are born with a tail a donkey! (...)
O People! Keep yourselves and fear your Lord. He may change the last people on Earth now, before Jesus
Christ (a) comes, to make some of them look like bears or gorillas. Are you understanding? He is able to
change them and He is warning, "O People! Maybe one day you will awaken and look in the mirror and see a
monkey or a pig." Laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billah.
All such wrong ideas are coming from Shaytan to western people, and I am sorry to say that the Islamic world
is also running after such foolish ideas and now Muslims think like western people about the Lord of Heavens
and His Creation. Maybe one day all of them will be changed! Allah, Allah!
O People! I am thinking that now, in this holy month of Ramadan, it may be a new beginning for this planet
and that maybe something is going to appear against technology. The European monkeys are proud that they
brought such foolish instruments and technology and did so many things with it. They believe in a 15centimeter instrument and are so proud that they made so many things with their hands. The Lord of
Heavens is giving them a chance to think about it, saying, “You are doing so many things, but there are
perhaps a billion subjects you may keep. You are making that instrument and there are ten other pieces of
knowledge that you are not keeping in your head!”
That is something for people to think about. How can they make an instrument and buy it for 10 pounds or

50 pounds or 500 piasters and so on? Yes, you are knowing this but you are not knowing that. How can they
do this? Because you are veiled. That is not veiled; it may be seen, but you can’t see it and they are making
that instrument.
O People! Think about it and remember your honor, that you have been honored by your Creator. Try to
make Him happy with you. Leave wrong ways and wrong ideas so the Lord of Heavens, your Creator, will be
happy with you. If He is angry with you, you will be under the level of every creature.
This is the holy month of Ramadan and I don’t know everything that is happening on Earth in this holy
month, but if heavenly power waves come, they will take away everything and make them know nothing! That
will perhaps occur this year or next year; it is so close now. When Imam al-Mahdi (a) comes, (Mawlana
Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) he will stop everything
associated with technology; finished. He will make them lower than the level of animals, taking away
technology so they can never be proud afterwards. May Allah (swt) forgive us.
O People! Think on it. If anything is said now, write it and send it to this person who is declaring to the whole
world, if you have such power to stop me from speaking. May Allah (swt) forgive us.
O People! Pray for yourself, pray for me and for all Mankind. Try to keep the honor of this holy month so you
will be under protection both here and Hereafter, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets Sayyidina Muhammad
(s)! (Mawlana Shaykh satnds and sits)
Fatihah.
(Shahada, baya` )
